name: Infinite Bliss

approach_variants.name: FR 5620 pulloff to the base of the west peak slab
approach_variants.notes:
I-90 Exit 34 east of North Bend, east on Edgewick Road, then right at the stop sign after 0.4 miles onto SE Middle Fork Road, which becomes FR 56. Drive about 12.3 miles to the Middle Fork / Taylor River junction just after the Taylor River bridge, turn right onto road 5620 and go about a mile to a small gravel pulloff — five cars at most — near 47.54604, -121.52151 at about 1,174 ft. Washouts on the Middle Fork road have periodically added a mile or more of walking.

The path leaves the road a hundred to two hundred yards further along, on the left, marked by a cairn. From there it climbs steeply through forest switchbacks for roughly 30 to 45 minutes. The tread is not signed but it is genuinely worn: if you have been walking more than a few minutes on ground that does not look like a trail, you are off it.
hazards: Rockfall down the lower slab pitches — bent hangers record it
Road washouts on the Middle Fork road adding approach distance
No water on the approach or the route
approach_variants.baseFinding:
About 50 yards below the start of the climbing there is a large cairn built of flat white rocks — by a clear margin the biggest cairn on the approach trail, and the marker to look for. The base itself sits near 47.549, -121.5137 at about 1,700 ft.

From there the confirmation is bolts. This is a continuous bolted line up the slab, so a slab with no bolts on it is not the route. Two supporting details: the lower pitches are easy, low-angle and somewhat runout on solid, sometimes water-polished slab; and several hangers down there are visibly bent from rockfall coming down the route, which both identifies the ground and tells you why to keep moving through it. Parties simulclimbing the easy lower pitches have gone off-track precisely by not tracking the bolts.

approach: Park at the gravel pull-off (~47.54604, -121.52151, ~1,174 ft). Follow NF-110/NF-5620 uphill roughly 10-15 minutes, then hike about 45 minutes, mostly uphill through forest switchbacks, to the route start near 47.549, -121.5137.
